description: Real FiPy accumulation-column concentration fields for the eight chemically-necessary prebiotic solutes, each with its own Soret coefficient and diffusivity, at successive FVM sweeps (t=0 / transient / settled) in a favourable serpentinite pore vs an open-pore wash-through control. All fields are read from the genuine FiPy solve; co-localization, enrichment and the flux residual are derived from those fields.

geometry.axis: z (axial, along pore); base z=0 (trapped), feed z=L (top)

colocalization_index.canonical_source: workspace/studies/og-spatial-concentration/artifacts/og-03-dilution-to-localized-individuals/colocalization_grid.json (strong-Soret FEM audit point; the study's headline ~0.18 — reported, not changed)

mass_conservation.note: FVM flux-divergence residual across all arms/species (direct LU); ~machine epsilon.

transport_decomposition.note: beta = geom * (soret * delta_T) * pe_conv / pore_width * (1 - porosity); accumulation Peclet = beta * pore_length = ln(enrichment). THERMOPHORESIS = soret * delta_T (Soret drift toward the cold wall); ADVECTION = pe_conv = flow_velocity * pore_width / D (convective Peclet); DIFFUSION = D (smooths the column); CONFINEMENT = 1 - porosity (the open-pore control sends this -> ~0).

requested_future_simulation.reason: The thermophoretic_concentration trap solver is a 1-D vertical accumulation column (Grid1D), so it resolves the AXIAL field only. A true 2-D/3-D radial field (converging-diverging throat geometry) requires the dolfinx FEM reference FenicsMultisolutePoreProcess, which is conda-only and runs under viva-fenics's pixi env (dolfinx not importable in this uv venv). Flagged here, never fabricated.
